_: The Oldest House (fan work after Remedy Entertainment's Control). Metres; x east, z south, y up; north is -z. Each sector is built by its module (src/oldesthouse/) round its 'at', inside its 'box' (relative to 'at'). The sectors are laid out round the Executive Sector the way the Bureau's blueprints show them: Research west, Maintenance east, Containment north, Investigations south, the Foundation below, the Astral Plane far above, and the tower on its street to the south.
name: The Oldest House

house.p: Headquarters of the Federal Bureau of Control: a brutalist tower in Manhattan that passers-by somehow never notice, and inside it far more building than the outside could hold. It is a Place of Power, and it rearranges itself. Here are its sectors as the Bureau's blueprints lay them out - Executive in the middle; Research to the west; Maintenance to the east; Containment to the north; Investigations to the south; the Foundation below; the Astral Plane above everything.
house.sub: Fan work after Remedy Entertainment's Control. X lifts and lowers the ceilings.
